# Perla powered by Hung Phat

> Perla powered by Hung Phat is a luxury ceramic tile and architectural surface purveyor in Vietnam, offering European-standard porcelain slabs, large-format sintered stone, and bespoke architectural finishes for luxury residences, commercial spaces, and high-end hospitality projects.

## Core Offerings

- [Porcelain Slabs & Ceramic Catalog](https://perla.com.vn/vi/products): Large-format sintered porcelain stone slabs, marble-look ceramics, travertine, and architectural wall & floor surfaces.
- [Featured Portfolio & Projects](https://perla.com.vn/vi/projects): High-end villa, penthouse, and hospitality architectural installations across Vietnam.
- [About Perla](https://perla.com.vn/vi/about): Brand heritage, craftsmanship standards, sustainable manufacturing partnerships, and European design philosophy.
- [Contact & Showrooms](https://perla.com.vn/vi/contact): Direct architectural consulting, bespoke slab specifications, and showroom visits in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.

## Technical Specifications

- Material standard: High-density porcelain, sintered stone (1200x2400mm, 800x1600mm, 600x1200mm, 800x800mm formats).
- Surface finishes: Polished (bóng), Honed (mờ), Structured (sần nhẹ), Silk satin.
- Applications: Flooring, facade cladding, kitchen islands, bathroom vanity surfaces, feature walls.
